1..16
ok 1 wp done is blocked while a WP AC is uncovered
ok 2 st done is blocked when the ST-level sign-off AC is unsatisfied
ok 3 st done is allowed once every AC including sign-off is satisfied
ok 4 gate blocks a present contract with zero in-scope ACs
ok 5 gate blocks a missing acceptance.md (no contract)
ok 6 gate passes and reports EXEMPT for acceptance: exempt with zero ACs
ok 7 gate unaffected by a real satisfied contract; still blocks unsatisfied and malformed
ok 8 wp done honours the WP-lenient granularity rule
ok 9 gate blocks loudly on a malformed AC id instead of silently dropping it
ok 10 gate blocks an unresolvable steel thread instead of passing vacuously
ok 11 gate blocks an unresolvable work package instead of passing vacuously
ok 12 gate still grants the WP-lenient rollup to a WP that exists, and announces it
ok 13 gate announces the pass so a verified contract cannot read as an empty one
ok 14 every ac/at reader refuses an unresolvable target instead of reporting an empty set
ok 15 a non-numeric work package number is a clean error, not raw bash arithmetic
ok 16 no opt-in or closes-as-before claim survives in canon and comments
